create_robot_agent: create a RobotAgent instance with a RobotClient, semantic sensor, and parameters dict to control a home robot
run_exploration: run the robot agent exploration loop to navigate frontiers and map the environment using voxel grid
grasp_object: grasp a specified object by name using the robot agent grasp method and grasp client
navigate_to_instance: navigate the robot to a detected instance using motion planning via RRTConnect and the voxel map
publish_observation: publish the robot observation data to a pickle file for UI visualization and debugging
